project_info.network_architecture: Multi-tier cloud architecture with secure ingestion layer, centralized data lake, processing layer, and multiple consumption endpoints. VPN/Direct Connect for secure connectivity to customer-hosted systems. Comprehensive management and security layer spanning the entire platform.
key_components: Data Ingestion Layer (AppFlow, Transfer for SFTP, Snow Family)
Data Lake (S3 with Lake Formation governance)
Data Processing & Cataloging (Glue Crawlers, Data Catalog)
Security & Governance Layer (IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, Macie)
project_info.\"description\": "Data consumed by business intelligence tools, custom applications, and ML workflows"
